notes: `latest.json` push failed on CI — missing git identity** — the `update-latest-json.sh` script ran `git commit` without configuring `user.name`/`user.email`, causing `fatal: empty ident name`. Added `git config` calls in the script before committing. | `latest.json` notes extraction** — the workflow step was trying to use `head -1` on the release notes file, which captured only the markdown heading. Replaced with structured Python parsing that extracts bullet points from the CHANGELOG section.
